inputs: requirements/lock.in (26 direct inputs: pyproject runtime/dev/api/openai unions + audit tools/build + jsonschema + setuptools/wheel build backend + win32 conditionals)
lock_install_command: python -m pip install --require-hashes -r requirements/lock.txt && python -m pip install --no-deps --no-build-isolation -e .

platform_appendix.command: python scripts/generate_lock_appendix.py --input requirements/lock.in --output <appendix> (concatenated after the compiler region under a delimited banner)
platform_appendix.rationale: pip-compile prunes markers missing the compiling interpreter; appendix restores the win32-only closure with index-digest hashes

regeneration: re-run compile_command with the pinned tool, re-run the appendix command, concatenate, then run scripts/verify_dependency_lock.py [--with-network]
target_interpreter: CPython 3.12 (CI); compiling interpreter 3.14 with requires-python + closure gates proving 3.12 installability
verification: scripts/verify_dependency_lock.py (offline PASS 2026-09-15; --with-network PASS 2026-09-15: requires-python>=3.12 floor, 3.12 linux/win32 closure, appendix drift)
